meta.name: Hasmukh
meta.description: A shy comedian gets his big break but soon realises he needs to murder people in order to keep his mojo on stage.

videos.title: Pakodey Thande The
videos.overview: After years of being denied a chance to open for his vile mentor, aspiring small-town comedian Hasmukh takes drastic action for a coveted turn onstage.

videos.title: Ek Tha Azmat, Ek Thi Kismat
videos.overview: Hasmukh’s past haunts him as he continues his vicious pre-show ritual. Amid scandal in Mumbai, TV executive Sinha seeks new talent for his comedy show.

videos.title: Jimmy The Maker
videos.overview: Newly discovered by Alpha TV, Hasmukh is brought to Mumbai. As Jimmy’s confidence swells after a successful meeting, Rhea offers a word of caution.

videos.title: Bambai Main Bambu
videos.overview: A betrayal against Hasmukh is thwarted. At a party, Jimmy spots their potential next victim. Ahead of his performance, Hasmukh faces an unexpected snag.

videos.title: Case Closed
videos.overview: The initial Comedy Baadshaho results spark surprise and anger. A sudden death raises suspicions. A meeting with don Jameel Indori inspires Hasmukh.

videos.title: Hum Acche Aadmi Nahin Hain
videos.overview: As the police question Hasmukh and Jimmy, Promila steps in. KK receives a threat from Indori. Hasmukh makes a potentially disastrous confession.

videos.title: Machalte Huye Hormones
videos.overview: After another death, planted evidence leads the police to Indori. When movie star Rahul Kapoor arrives to judge the show, Hasmukh seizes an opportunity.

videos.title: Peti Killer
videos.overview: Following a mishap with Kapoor, Hasmukh is blindsided when his act is stolen and performed by his rival. Left to perform without a script, he goes rogue.

videos.title: Ek Writer Ki Maut
videos.overview: Low on morale, Jimmy shuts Rhea out. Naik makes a discovery about Hasmukh’s ex-mentor. Ajinkya tries to prove his loyalty to KK, with tragic results.

videos.title: Sab Samay Ka Khel Hai
videos.overview: Hours before the show, Jimmy and Hasmukh catch up to Ajinkya, and Hasmukh’s past catches up to him. Hasmukh and KK go head-to-head in a shocking finale.
